caption: The drawing consists of two separate rectangular sections positioned vertically on a white background. Both sections are predominantly rendered in shades of light red and pink, with the upper section being smaller than the lower one. The upper section features loosely arranged, short, curved red strokes and several irregular gray patches dispersed throughout the pale pinkish area. The lower, larger section contains a denser composition with a uniform wash of reddish-pink as the base color, covered in scattered light gray spots and curved, sweeping gray-black lines throughout, creating a pattern-like effect. There are no distinct, easily identifiable objects; the drawing primarily consists of abstract marks and color fields.
title: Fragment of Wall Decoration
